article.title: AI News Roundup
article.contentText:
Artificial intelligence companies announced several major partnerships this week.

Researchers from Open University demonstrated a new model that improves factual
consistency.

Regulators in multiple regions also proposed updated guidance for safety testing.

Market analysts expect enterprise adoption to accelerate through the next quarter.
